label: CardioFic-003 | Phase III, cardiology
documentText:
CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL: CardioFic-003
A Phase III, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of CVX-12 in adults with chronic heart failure
Sponsor: CardiaNova Ltd. Protocol code CN-003. Version 1.4.

1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Title, code, version/date, sponsor, steering committee and site list with contacts are provided.

2. BACKGROUND
Mechanistic rationale for CVX-12, summary of Phase II results and benefit-risk rationale are described with references.

3. OBJECTIVES
Primary: time to first heart-failure hospitalisation or cardiovascular death. Secondary: functional class, quality of life. Clear and measurable.

4. TRIAL DESIGN
Randomised 1:1, double-blind, placebo-controlled, event-driven. Randomisation and blinding procedures, and unblinding rules, are described.

5. SELECTION AND WITHDRAWAL OF SUBJECTS
Inclusion/exclusion criteria, withdrawal and discontinuation procedures are defined.

6. TREATMENT OF SUBJECTS
Dose, titration, blinding of study drug, and concomitant-medication rules are specified.

7. ASSESSMENT OF EFFICACY
Endpoint adjudication by an independent clinical events committee is described, with assessment timing.

8. ASSESSMENT OF SAFETY
Adverse-event collection is described and a Data Safety Monitoring Board is mentioned. SAE reporting timelines to authorities are not fully specified and the DSMB charter is referenced but not summarised.

9. STATISTICS
Event-driven sample size with power assumptions, primary analysis model, and handling of missing data are documented, including a pre-specified interim analysis.

10. DIRECT ACCESS TO SOURCE DATA/DOCUMENTS
Direct-access statement for monitoring, audit and inspection is included.

11. QUALITY CONTROL AND QUALITY ASSURANCE
Central and on-site monitoring approach and data-quality checks are described.

12. ETHICS
Declaration of Helsinki, IRB/IEC and informed consent (including any substudy consent) are described.

13. DATA HANDLING AND RECORD KEEPING
Data management plan, eCRF and retention are specified.

14. FINANCING AND INSURANCE
Insurance cover and financing are referenced in a separate agreement.

15. PUBLICATION POLICY
A single sentence states results will be published, without authorship or timing arrangements.

16. SUPPLEMENTS
Appendices are listed as 'to be provided' but not attached to this version.
